Axiom: The interview ends when the coverage map is closed — every topic `✅` or explicitly skipped with a recorded reason — never when a question count is reached, and never by a silent Approval Check. After every operator answer, re-check the map: an answer that opens a new hole or risk adds a topic or reopens a closed one (thread-pulling per `AX_OPERATOR_SAFEGUARD` — that axiom owns the instinct; this one binds it to the map). A skip on a high-stakes topic goes through `H_HIGH_STAKES_SKIP`.
